messages.content: Translate the question into Italian if it is in English, into English if it is in Italian. Keep names, numbers and dates. Return only the translation.
Given that the company works in mining areas (extractive sector), how often must the IGEA-PRIM 5t overhead travelling crane at position 13 be verified?

response.text: Data la circostanza che l'azienda opera in aree minerarie (settore estrattivo), ogni quanto tempo deve essere verificata la gru a ponte scorrevole IGEA-PRIM da 5t in posizione 13?
